## POST `/api/types/ipPort/action/recommendForInterface`

**Tier:** T1–T3 (action: read its description)  

Recommend ipPorts on the specified SP to create the network interfaces on. This is a static method which applies to the ipPort resource type instead of specific ipPort resource instances. The most suitable ipPort is placed on top of the returned list. It is chosen according to its I/O Module number, link status, aggregation state, and the amount of interfaces on it. The rest of ports is sorted sequentially by I/O Module number, aggregation state and name.

_3 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Request body** (required): `inline`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `storageProcessor` | object | Storage processor for which to recommend ipPorts. |
| `usage` | `IPRecommendUsageEnum` | \|Name\|Value\|Description\| \|----------\|----------\|----------\| \|File\|1\|\| \|ISCSI\|2\|\| |

**Responses:** `200` OK body fields: `updated`, `content`
